dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of discrete, high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated on the lower lateral flanks and posterior dorsal surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three prominent rings on the upper mid-back form a small triangular configuration.
